blockers.message: the review record has no `## plan.challenge` section, while roles were active at it

findings.evidence:
3. Revoke the old token from the same page. Requests that still carry it
   are refused with `401 Unauthorized`.
findings.recommendation: Point the section at the code that enforces token revocation (or the service that owns it), or drop the guarantee until it is backed by an implementation and a test; an integrator relying on revocation after an exposure must not be told it works if it does not.
findings.title: Documented revocation guarantee has no implementation in this repository

findings.evidence:
API tokens do not expire. Rotate a token when a person who knew it leaves
the team, or when it may have been exposed:
findings.recommendation: Recommend a periodic rotation as well (for example every 90 days), since a leak that goes unnoticed is otherwise valid forever; consider tracking token expiry as a follow-up for the service itself.
findings.title: Non-expiring tokens documented without a periodic rotation recommendation
